source: Release names from a production rex library (2026-10-13) and the TMDB show, season and episode each is, read off TMDB by hand: Bleach's Thousand-Year Blood War is its season 2 numbered through all four cours, Cinderella Gray's second cour is episodes 14-23 of its one season, Dr. Stone New World's second cour episodes 12-22 of season 3. anime-lists maps the Ikinokore OVA to TMDB special 8 while TMDB now lists it as 6 and 7, so specials are as right as that list. Erai-raws' `Shiguang Dailiren Season 3` came out in August 2026 with TMDB's season 4, Link Click 3; TMDB's season 3 is the six-episode Bridon Arc of 2024. A bare title several entries share is the show's first season: `Ranma ½` is also a synonym of Ranma 1/2 Nettou Hen (TMDB season 2) and of the 2024 remake, and the production server's start-up pass moved 256 of Cleo's 1989 BD files to a season 2 (rehearsal, 2026-10-14). anime-lists maps Dragon Ball Z and Monster Farm (Monster Rancher) to TMDB with `tmdbseason="a"`, absolute numbering: the show's entry, numbering nothing, rather than a special or a later season sharing its title (the rehearsal moved DBZ 001 to S0E1 and Monster Rancher 17 to S3E17).
